nodes.description: Privileged manager address allowed to commit, roll, close shorts, sell options and set fees.
Address of the option the vault will short in the next cycle.
Timestamp after which nextOption can be rolled into via rollToNextOption.
Address of the option the vault is currently shorting.
Amount of asset currently locked into the short position.
Maximum total balance allowed to be deposited into the vault.
Fee applied on instant withdrawals, expressed in 10**18 units.
Address receiving the withdrawal fees.
Immutable IProtocolAdapter used for staticcall and delegatecall interactions.
Immutable collateral and premium asset of the vault.
Immutable Wrapped Ether contract address.
Immutable USDC contract address used as strike asset.
Immutable AirSwap swap contract used to sell option tokens.
Immutable minimum supply enforced for asset balance and share supply.
Constant ratio (0.9 ether) of asset balance locked when shorting.
Constant one hour delay before a committed option can be rolled to.
Sets immutable variables (asset, adapter, WETH, USDC, swap, decimals, minimum supply).
Initializer guarded by the initializer modifier, sets owner, cap, feeRecipient and withdrawal fee.
onlyOwner function updating the privileged manager address.
onlyOwner function updating the fee recipient address.
onlyManager function updating the instant withdrawal fee with a 30% ceiling.
Payable nonReentrant deposit of ETH wrapped through IWETH into vault shares.
nonReentrant deposit of asset via safeTransferFrom then _deposit.
Private share minting logic that checks cap, MINIMUM_SUPPLY and computes pool shares.
nonReentrant withdrawal that unwraps WETH and forwards ETH to msg.sender via low-level call.
nonReentrant withdrawal transferring asset to the caller via SafeERC20.
Private burn/withdraw logic computing amounts and paying the fee recipient.
onlyManager nonReentrant function that sets nextOption and closes the existing short.
nonReentrant public wrapper that closes the current short via _closeShort.
Private validation and assignment of nextOption and nextOptionReadyAt using block.timestamp.
Private logic that closes the short, using block.timestamp expiry checks and adapter delegatecall.
onlyManager nonReentrant function that locks funds and opens a new short via delegateCreateShort.
onlyManager nonReentrant emergency closure of the current short via delegatecall.
onlyManager function performing an AirSwap swap of the current option token.
onlyManager function updating the deposit cap.
Public view computing withdrawable amount and fee for a given share amount.
Private view converting shares to asset amounts using lockedAmount and total supply.
View returning the maximum withdrawable shares for all users.
View returning the maximum asset amount withdrawable by an account.
View converting an asset amount into vault shares.
View returning lockedAmount plus the on-contract asset balance.
View returning the freely withdrawable asset balance of the vault.
Caller address used for access control, deposits and withdrawals.
Block timestamp used for option readiness, expiry and roll timing.
ProtocolAdapter.delegateCloseShort performs a delegatecall into the adapter.
ProtocolAdapter.delegateCreateShort performs a delegatecall into the adapter.
msg.sender.call{value: withdrawAmount}('') in withdrawETH forwards ETH to an arbitrary caller.
SWAP_CONTRACT.swap(order) external call to the AirSwap contract.
SafeERC20 safeTransfer/safeTransferFrom/safeApprove external token calls.
IWETH deposit/withdraw external calls wrapping and unwrapping ETH.
Share amount parameter supplied to withdraw.
Asset amount parameter supplied to deposit.
New manager address parameter supplied to setManager.
Option terms calldata parameter supplied to commitAndClose.
Local withdrawAmount computed in withdrawETH and sent to msg.sender.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against the manager state variable in the onlyManager modifier.
initialize depends on the caller for ownership setup and is guarded by the initializer modifier.
setWithdrawalFee is gated by onlyManager which checks msg.sender against manager.
deposit pulls tokens from the untrusted msg.sender via safeTransferFrom.
rollToNextOption is gated by onlyManager which checks msg.sender against manager.
sellOptions is gated by onlyManager which checks msg.sender against manager.
_setNextOption derives nextOptionReadyAt from block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
_closeShort uses block.timestamp compared to option expiry (timestamp dependency).
rollToNextOption requires block.timestamp to be past nextOptionReadyAt (timestamp dependency).
The adapter state variable is the delegatecall target for closing shorts.
The adapter state variable is the delegatecall target for creating shorts.
SWAP_CONTRACT state variable is the target of the external swap call.
withdrawETH executes the low-level ETH transfer to msg.sender.
The ETH transfer hands control to msg.sender which may reenter withdrawETH before state settles.
_closeShort calls adapter.delegateCloseShort.
emergencyWithdrawFromShort calls adapter.delegateCloseShort.
rollToNextOption calls adapter.delegateCreateShort.
sellOptions invokes SWAP_CONTRACT.swap(order).
deposit uses SafeERC20 safeTransferFrom to move tokens.
_withdraw uses SafeERC20 safeTransfer for user and fee amounts.
rollToNextOption uses safeApprove on the option token.
withdrawETH calls IWETH.withdraw to unwrap WETH.
depositETH calls IWETH.deposit to wrap ETH.
depositETH forwards the wrapped amount to _deposit.
deposit forwards the deposited amount to _deposit.
withdraw calls _withdraw to burn shares and compute the payout.
withdrawETH calls _withdraw before unwrapping.
_withdraw calls withdrawAmountWithShares to obtain amounts.
commitAndClose first calls _setNextOption.
commitAndClose then calls _closeShort.
totalBalance reads lockedAmount.
totalBalance reads the asset balance via IERC20(asset).balanceOf.
assetBalance reads the asset balance via IERC20(asset).balanceOf.
_withdrawAmountWithShares reads lockedAmount to compute the total.
withdrawAmountWithShares reads instantWithdrawalFee to compute the fee.
_deposit reads cap to enforce the deposit limit.
initialize writes the cap state variable.
setCap writes the cap state variable.
setWithdrawalFee writes instantWithdrawalFee.
setManager writes the manager state variable.
setFeeRecipient writes feeRecipient.
_setNextOption writes nextOption.
_setNextOption writes nextOptionReadyAt.
_closeShort reads and clears currentOption.
_closeShort resets lockedAmount to zero.
rollToNextOption writes currentOption.
rollToNextOption writes lockedAmount.
emergencyWithdrawFromShort reads and clears currentOption.
_deposit enforces MINIMUM_SUPPLY on balance and share supply.
withdrawAmountWithShares enforces MINIMUM_SUPPLY checks.
The share parameter feeds withdraw.
The amount parameter feeds deposit.
The newManager parameter feeds setManager.
The optionTerms parameter feeds commitAndClose.
Local withdrawAmount is the value passed to the ETH transfer inside withdrawETH.

normalization_plan.reason: The share parameter only exists as input to withdraw and should be merged into that core function.
The amount parameter only exists as input to deposit and should be merged into that core function.
The newManager parameter only exists as input to setManager and should be merged into that core function.
The optionTerms parameter only exists as input to commitAndClose and should be merged into that core function.
The local withdrawAmount is computed inside withdrawETH and should be merged into that core function.
